title: Local finite presentation and flatness of a flat support after an elementary etale neighbourhood
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that if a locally finite type scheme over a base is flat at a point, then after an elementary etale neighbourhood of the image there is an open subscheme of the base change containing the lifted point on which the morphism to the local base is flat and of finite presentation (statement lines 2844-2857, tag 05I9-adjacent). The proof embeds the source into an affine space over the base, applies the local structure statement to the pushforward of the structure sheaf, and intersects the resulting open subscheme with the base change. The reduction is the substance, so the claim is H2.
